name: errors-duck-typing-through-an-interface
description: A type whose value enters an interface of the program's own that the program converts to error, directly or through a further interface, is reachable as an error, so its Unwrap method is retained by the errors-duck-typing class. The conversion counts only while the declaration holding it is live: a value that enters an interface whose only conversion to error an uncalled function holds keeps no Unwrap, which falls with that function.
